data.desc: Liquidia Corporation is a biopharmaceutical company driven by science and compassion to revolutionize care for patients with challenging respiratory and vascular diseases through precise, innovative therapies and applications of its proprietary PRINT technology. PRINT enabled the development of YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)[ and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD)].
